# Multi-year spatial plot across combined trays
ggplot(df_spatial_combined, aes(x = x, y = y, color = state, shape = state)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = state), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Vegetative" = "forestgreen",
    "Flowering"  = "magenta3",
    "Dormant"    = "orange2",
    "Dead"       = "red4",
    "Unknown"    = "black"
  )) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Vegetative" = 16,  
    "Flowering"  = 8,   
    "Dormant"    = 18,  
    "Dead"       = 15,
    "Unknown"    = 17
  )) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(
    "Vegetative" = 2.2,
    "Flowering"  = 3.0,
    "Dormant"    = 2.5,
    "Dead"       = 2.5,
    "Unknown"    = 2.5
  )) +
  facet_grid(year ~ combined_tray, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Tray Maps (2022–2026)",
    color = "Plant Status",
    shape = "Plant Status",
    size  = "Plant Status"
  ) +
  xlim(450, 0) + ylim(30, 650) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
